params.message:
Let the Netwerk graph follow who takes over what

Around a relation in focus the names say who takes each over, and the
panel suggests takers from the relations it shares most projects with.
A row of names above the graph lights one person's relations and the
untaken ones around them. A project lists who takes over each of its
relations. Saving a relation on the list opens the next one.
